\chapter{三角函数}\label{ch:g12:trigo}
=
The functions $\cos$ and $\sin$ turn the geometry of the circle into
analysis. Defined by winding the real line around the unit circle, they are
the archetype of periodic functions, and their derivatives make them
solutions of the equation of oscillations $y'' = -y$.
=
\section{单位圆}
=
\begin{definition}[余弦与正弦]\label{def:g12:trigo:cossin}
设 $\mathcal{C}$ 为正交坐标系原点处的半径为 1 的圆。对每个实数 $t$，将它对应到点 $M(t)$：从点 $I(1,0)$ 出发沿 $\mathcal{C}$ 绕过长度为 $\abs{t}$ 的弧，当 $t \geq 0$ 时按逆时针方向，否则按顺时针方向。则
\emph{$\cos t$ 与 $\sin t$ 是点 $M(t)$ 的坐标}\index{余弦}\index{正弦}：
=
\[
=
M(t) = (\cos t, \sin t).
=
\]
\end{definition}
=
\begin{omfigure}
=
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=2.2]
=
  \draw[->] (-1.25,0) -- (1.35,0) node[right] {$x$};
=
  \draw[->] (0,-1.25) -- (0,1.35) node[above] {$y$};
=
  \draw (0,0) circle (1);
=
  \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
=
  \coordinate (M) at (50:1);
=
  \draw[thick,omDef] (O) -- (M);
=
  \fill (M) circle (0.6pt) node[above right] {$M(t)$};
=
  \fill (1,0) circle (0.6pt) node[below right] {$I$};
=
  \draw[dashed] (M) -- (M |- O) node[below,pos=1.05] {$\cos t$};
=
  \draw[dashed] (M) -- (M -| O) node[left,pos=1.02] {$\sin t$};
=
  \draw[->,omThm,thick] (0.35,0) arc (0:50:0.35);
=
  \node[omThm] at (25:0.5) {$t$};
=
\end{tikzpicture}
=
\end{omfigure}
=
由于圆的周长为 $2\pi$，当 $t$ 增加 $2\pi$ 时点 $M(t)$ 不变；又因 $M(t)$ 位于单位圆上，有：
=
\begin{proposition}[基本恒等式]\label{prop:g12:trigo:identities}
=
对所有 $t \in \R$ 与 $k \in \Z$，有
=
\[
=
\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1, \qquad
=
\cos(t + 2k\pi) = \cos t, \qquad
=
\sin(t + 2k\pi) = \sin t,
=
\]
=
\[
=
\cos(-t) = \cos t, \qquad \sin(-t) = -\sin t,
=
\]
=
\[
=
\cos(\pi - t) = -\cos t, \quad \sin(\pi - t) = \sin t, \quad
=
\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2} - t\right) = \sin t, \quad
=
\sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2} - t\right) = \cos t .
=
\]
=
\end{proposition}
=
\begin{proof}
=
第一个恒等式即单位圆的方程；其余各式表达圆的对称性：$M(-t)$ 是 $M(t)$ 关于 $x$ 轴的对称点，$M(\pi - t)$ 是关于 $y$ 轴的对称点，$M(\frac\pi2 - t)$ 是关于直线 $y = x$ 的对称点。
=
\end{proof}
=
需要熟记的数值：
=
\begin{center}
=
\begin{tabular}{c|ccccc}
=
$t$ & $0$ & $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ & $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ & $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ & $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$\\[6pt]
=
\hline\rule{0pt}{14pt}%
=
$\cos t$ & $1$ & $\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$ & $\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$ & $\dfrac12$ & $0$\\[6pt]
=
$\sin t$ & $0$ & $\dfrac12$ & $\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}$ & $\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$ & $1$
=
\end{tabular}
=
\end{center}
=
\begin{proposition}[加法公式]\label{prop:g12:trigo:addition}
=
对所有 $a, b \in \R$，有
=
\begin{align*}
=
\cos(a+b) &= \cos a \cos b - \sin a \sin b, &
=
\sin(a+b) &= \sin a \cos b + \cos a \sin b,\\
=
\cos(a-b) &= \cos a \cos b + \sin a \sin b, &
=
\sin(a-b) &= \sin a \cos b - \cos a \sin b.
=
\end{align*}
=
特别地，$\cos 2a = 2\cos^2 a - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2 a$，且
=
$\sin 2a = 2 \sin a \cos a$。
=
\end{proposition}
=
\begin{proof}
=
向量 $\vect{u} = (\cos a, \sin a)$ 与 $\vect{v} = (\cos b, \sin b)$ 为单位向量，其夹角为 $a - b$；它们的数量积一方面等于 $\cos a\cos b + \sin a \sin b$（用坐标计算），另一方面等于 $\norm{\vect u}\,\norm{\vect v}\cos(a-b) = \cos(a - b)$（用几何方法计算），这就得到第三个公式。将 $b$ 换为 $-b$ 即得第一个公式；正弦公式利用 $\sin x = \cos(\frac\pi2 - x)$ 推出。倍角公式是取 $b = a$ 并结合 $\cos^2 + \sin^2 = 1$ 所得。
=
\end{proof}
=
\section{分析研究}
=
\begin{lemma}[基本极限]\label{lem:g12:trigo:sinxx}
=
\[
=
\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin t}{t} = 1
=
\qquad\text{and}\qquad
=
\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\cos t - 1}{t} = 0 .
=
\]
=
\end{lemma}
=
\begin{proof}
=
对 $0 < t < \frac{\pi}{2}$，比较单位圆中的三块面积：三角形 $OIM(t)$、扇形 $OIM(t)$，以及底边为 $OI$、高为 $\tan t$ 的直角三角形：
=
\[
=
\frac{\sin t}{2} \leq \frac{t}{2} \leq \frac{\tan t}{2}.
=
\]
=
